description: Power quality network analyser. Selection of the live values, voltage and power values and the event status coils.

sources.title: Modbus - Data Points, Power Quality Network Analyser PQI-DA smart
sources.note: data point tables; the connection settings are in the operating instructions, chapters 5.9 and 13

notes: More than 5000 values exist in the device (harmonics, interharmonics, supraharmonics, 10 ms and 10 s minimum and maximum values, phasors). This map keeps the main measurements, power values and event status coils.

The data point list gives no register area, byte order or word order for the values. They are read here as holding registers (float32, big byte and word order) and the addresses are used as printed in the list. If values look wrong, try input registers or word_order little.
The list shows the same quantity in three places (for example the frequency at 102, 1008 and 41000). It does not say how they differ; the 41000 block is not included here.
The unit and RTU/TCP settings are not in the data point list: see the operating instructions. Not tested on a device.
